The two do not sit together and I built the spots without being able to ask anything about them.
Nothing in the catalogue covers a mode-select or difficulty-select marker, which is a very common Roblox lobby fixture. teleporter-link is the closest and is wrong unless the run is elsewhere.

notes_for_us: The clearest failure this batch: the prompt describes HUD buttons in screen corners and the downstream expansion placed them in the world as circular ground zones. genre-choice routes them to mechanics correctly, but the handoff has no way to say this is screen space, so a consumer reading the prompt alongside the handoff can still put them on the floor.

Two of the three enemy types fly, and there is no option or axis for enemies occupying airspace. CHECK is a pipeline flag about self-occlusion, not a statement that the fight is three-dimensional, so the vertical threat is carried in free text.
spawner-npc takes a single count for three species with different approach heights. One entry cannot say ground, low hover and overhead, and splitting into three entries duplicates the ID.
